verdict.rationale: Llama is a model family, but llama.com makes one thin first-party claim of an agentic tool you can delegate work to: "Multi-agent coding in your terminal." Function calling and agent-optimized inference are developer building blocks and earn no credit; the Meta Chat UI mention concerns a separate consumer app. Missing for 10: documentation of a built-in assistant and how tasks are delegated to it, its scope and supported task types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
